title: Runtime request
summary: Request accepted by a compatible runtime client.
purpose: Carries provider-neutral input and optional execution settings into startRun.
lifecycle: Created by the caller, validated by the provider adapter, and retained only when the upstream runtime persists a run.

fieldConstraints.constraint: Required runtime input supported by the selected provider.
Optional JSON-compatible provider metadata; unknown keys may be ignored upstream.

behavior.errors: Invalid input is rejected by the provider or upstream runtime.
behavior.retry: Retry only when the returned error is explicitly retryable.
behavior.cancellation: Cancellation occurs after a run identifier exists and support is capability-gated.
behavior.streaming: Streaming requires both the stream capability and streamRun implementation.

valid.expected: startRun returns a normalized run status.

invalid.expectedFailure: The required input is absent and the provider rejects the request.

compatibilityNotes: Provider-specific metadata remains owned by the upstream runtime.
